import gzip,json
from factor_engine.tools.catalog_recipe_migration import migrate_catalog_recipe_formula
rows=calls=0
with gzip.open("evidence/factor_catalog_20260915/input.jsonl.gz","rt") as f:
 for line in f:
  s=json.loads(line).get("formula")
  if not isinstance(s,str): continue
  try: r=migrate_catalog_recipe_formula(s)
  except SyntaxError: continue
  n=r.changes.count("ts_markov_persistence.min_periods -> min_count")
  rows += bool(n); calls += n
print("affected_rows",rows); print("affected_calls",calls)
